subject: Fail fast on empty CA directory at TLS config load (#3522)
reason: The change makes loadCaCertDir (src/tls.c) fail TLS context creation when tls-ca-cert-dir opens but contains no loadable CA certs. Reaching it requires a BUILD_TLS build plus a currently-valid server cert/key and CA material loaded before the changed function runs, and active TLS (tls-port/tls-replication/tls-cluster). The fuzzer has no TLS fragment, no cert-provisioning component, and no cert fixtures; the local provider rejects tls-port in server_config, so no installed experiment reaches this config-load path and it cannot be composed from installed components (valkey.action.commands cannot
